Initial owner setup

Access records are stored locally. Use signed Export Access Package / Import Access Update files to exchange user records between offline laptops. Packages contain password hashes and must be kept confidential. The Owner's initial administrator package also contains the named Administrator's private signing key and must be sent only to that Administrator. Verify the Owner fingerprint through a separate trusted channel on first import.

Owner recovery: this clears only the access register and current sign-in on this browser. It does not delete service reports, projects or machine records. Use only when intentionally establishing a new Owner account on this device.

Your account displays only the information and tools assigned to your access level. Other users’ account details are not shown.
